definitions.closure: First issued single-finger jaw target below 0.020 m, not measured closure or total aperture.
definitions.denominators: All scheduled rows retained. Full-episode metrics use only complete valid trajectories; prefix/refusal metrics are unavailable, never zero-imputed.
definitions.depth: Synthetic camera transforms do not validate depth accuracy; renderer warnings remain a separate limitation, not a demonstrated cause.
definitions.earlier: Earlier than the matched teacher in episode time; a different valid path or timing is allowed.
definitions.far_closure: XY distal TCP-object separation above 0.020 m at that command; descriptive posthoc threshold, not a preregistered task gate.
definitions.geometry: Saved native tick exactly at the decision boundary, before applying the new command; no t=0 native sample means geometry unavailable.
definitions.hidden_inputs: No phase, teacher, native object or future observation is inferred as a learner input here; source/model/control-authority bindings do not attest arbitrary external code.

scope: All 64 registered learned development attempts and 16 exact matched teacher demonstrations. Descriptive numeric reconstruction; not causal inference, qualification or a full media/perception audit.
